'''Indu San''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Indu San system/Legends|Indu San system]] inhabited by [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. It was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Its first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Governor, [[Stant Rosswell]], achieved a smooth transition of regime. Its second Imperial Governor, [[Ekam Ouwray]], was a [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] fanatic, resulting in rebellion of the populace. Ouwray fled the planet, which was liberated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Chief Councilor of the [[Indu Council]], President [[Shek Barayel]], was convinced to sign a treaty, joining the New Republic. However, before he could do so, Brarayel was assassinated by Imperial loyalist [[Kaleb Darme]], who tried to frame the New Republic. The truth was exposed by [[Kella Rand]] of the [[Galactic News Network]].

The local day lasted 25 standard [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]; the year lasted 382 local [[Standard day/Legends|days]].
